title: HCA Healthcare UK SACT patient education films
summary: A patient-education film for people about to start systemic anti-cancer therapy, with 13 short standalone chapters, researched with patients and made with HCA UK's clinical team.
body:
HCA Healthcare UK wanted to prepare patients for systemic anti-cancer therapy (SACT) before their first treatment.

We worked closely with the clinical team on the script and creative approach. A small crew of producer, camera operator and sound recordist filmed on site with minimal, lightweight kit, so we could work around a busy cancer centre without getting in the way.

The result is one full-length film of around 20 to 25 minutes and 13 short standalone chapters of around two minutes each, so patients can watch the whole story or go straight to the question on their mind. New illustrations with motion and animation support the explanations, HCA-branded graphics and thumbnails make each chapter clear on YouTube, and every film was mixed and graded.
